name: dashboard
description: Scripting OpenWrt（Nikki/OpenClash/Mihomo）与独立 Clash/Mihomo 面板：前台系统采样与 CPU 详情、代理模式与节点测速、规则及连接；Nikki 配置/订阅/附加规则编辑、服务与核心操作，含路由器详情预取、主题与安全日志。功能取决于插件版本与设备权限。

localizedDescriptions.zh: Scripting OpenWrt（Nikki/OpenClash/Mihomo）与独立 Clash/Mihomo 面板：前台系统采样与 CPU 详情、代理模式与节点测速、规则及连接；Nikki 配置/订阅/附加规则编辑、服务与核心操作，含路由器详情预取、主题与安全日志。功能取决于插件版本与设备权限。
localizedDescriptions.en: Scripting dashboard for OpenWrt (Nikki/OpenClash/Mihomo) and standalone Clash/Mihomo: foreground metrics and CPU details, proxy modes and testing, rules and connections; Nikki profile/subscription/rule editors, service and core operations, router-detail prefetch, themes and safe event logs. Features depend on plugin versions and device permissions.
